answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 156060 Country: india Title: Due for exam Question: Next month I have my exam. I study well and also write well but somehow I cannot pass my exam. kindly suggest me a dua to pass in my exam and also to increase my concentration suggest me dua. Answer ID: 156060 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 253/199/B=2/1439) Before sitting in the exam you should read Ya Aziz ( يَا عَزِيزُ ) twelve thousand times though you read it in many days and many stages. In-shaAllah, you shall pass. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
